verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no control protocol or API that lets an external coding agent drive the Warp terminal by creating panes, running commands in them, or reading their output. What it does show is adjacent. Warp's own built-in agent runs shell commands and reads live output. The Oz CLI and API manage cloud agent runs, not the terminal. The new settings file gives programmatic control over settings only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can let a coding agent programmatically drive the terminal itself — create panes, run commands, read output — through a documented control protocol or API
